description: Find the category_id for olx_search. Without arguments: OLX's 19 top-level categories. With parent_id: that category's sub-categories (instant, from a snapshot of OLX's category tree). With query: which categories the offers matching those words fall in, with live offer counts, largest first — the quickest way to pick a category for a search term (e.g. 'iphone 13' → Smartfony i telefony komórkowe > iPhone). Result: { source, parent, query?, total_count?, count, categories: [{ id, name, path, has_children, count? }] } — `path` is the full Polish name trail ('Nieruchomości > Mieszkania > Wynajem').

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

parent_id.description: List this category's sub-categories (e.g. 3 = Nieruchomości). With query: scope the counts to it.

query.description: Search words; returns the categories their offers fall in, with counts (one live request).

name: olx_categories
title: Browse OLX.pl categories
